name: sidebar-02
title: Sidebar 02
description: A collapsible sidebar with a version switcher, search form, and collapsible nav groups.

files.content:
import Sidebar from "../../components/ui/sidebar/sidebar.marko";
import SidebarHeader from "../../components/ui/sidebar/header.marko";
import SidebarContent from "../../components/ui/sidebar/content.marko";
import SidebarGroup from "../../components/ui/sidebar/group.marko";
import SidebarGroupLabel from "../../components/ui/sidebar/group-label.marko";
import SidebarMenu from "../../components/ui/sidebar/menu.marko";
import SidebarMenuItem from "../../components/ui/sidebar/menu-item.marko";
import SidebarMenuButton from "../../components/ui/sidebar/menu-button.marko";
import Collapsible from "../../components/ui/collapsible/collapsible.marko";
import VersionSwitcher from "./version-switcher.marko";
import SearchForm from "./search-form.marko";

export interface Input {
  open?: boolean;
}

static const VERSIONS = ["1.0.1", "1.1.0-alpha", "2.0.0-beta1"];

static const NAV_MAIN = [
  {
    title: "Getting Started",
    url: "#",
    items: [
      { title: "Installation", url: "#" },
      { title: "Project Structure", url: "#" },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: "Build Your Application",
    url: "#",
    items: [
      { title: "Routing", url: "#" },
      { title: "Data Fetching", url: "#", isActive: true },
      { title: "Rendering", url: "#" },
      { title: "Caching", url: "#" },
      { title: "Styling", url: "#" },
      { title: "Optimizing", url: "#" },
      { title: "Configuring", url: "#" },
      { title: "Testing", url: "#" },
      { title: "Authentication", url: "#" },
      { title: "Deploying", url: "#" },
      { title: "Upgrading", url: "#" },
      { title: "Examples", url: "#" },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: "API Reference",
    url: "#",
    items: [
      { title: "Components", url: "#" },
      { title: "File Conventions", url: "#" },
      { title: "Functions", url: "#" },
      { title: "next.config.js Options", url: "#" },
      { title: "CLI", url: "#" },
      { title: "Edge Runtime", url: "#" },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: "Architecture",
    url: "#",
    items: [
      { title: "Accessibility", url: "#" },
      { title: "Fast Refresh", url: "#" },
      { title: "Next.js Compiler", url: "#" },
      { title: "Supported Browsers", url: "#" },
      { title: "Turbopack", url: "#" },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: "Community",
    url: "#",
    items: [{ title: "Contribution Guide", url: "#" }],
  },
];

<Sidebar open=input.open>
  <@content>
    <SidebarHeader>
      <VersionSwitcher versions=VERSIONS defaultVersion=VERSIONS[0]/>
      <SearchForm/>
    </SidebarHeader>
    <SidebarContent class="gap-0">
      <for|group| of=NAV_MAIN by=(group) => group.title>
        <Collapsible defaultOpen=true class="group/collapsible">
          <@trigger|attrs|>
            <SidebarGroup>
              <SidebarGroupLabel
                ...attrs
                class="group/label w-full cursor-pointer text-sm text-sidebar-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground"
              >
                ${group.title}
                <svg
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  width="24"
                  height="24"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  stroke-width="2"
                  stroke-linecap="round"
                  stroke-linejoin="round"
                  class="ml-auto transition-transform group-data-[state=open]/collapsible:rotate-90"
                >
                  <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/>
                </svg>
              </SidebarGroupLabel>
            </SidebarGroup>
          </@trigger>
          <@content>
            <SidebarGroup class="pt-0">
              <SidebarMenu>
                <for|leaf| of=group.items by=(leaf) => leaf.title>
                  <SidebarMenuItem>
                    <SidebarMenuButton href=leaf.url active=leaf.isActive>${leaf.title}</SidebarMenuButton>
                  </SidebarMenuItem>
                </for>
              </SidebarMenu>
            </SidebarGroup>
          </@content>
        </Collapsible>
      </for>
    </SidebarContent>
  </@content>
</Sidebar>
